title: Especialista em Operações Cripto e Carteiras Digitais
description:
Sobre a vaga

Se você já perdeu o sono acompanhando uma liquidez secar numa DEX às 3h da manhã, ou já organizou uma migração de fundos entre cold wallets sem deixar ninguém dormir tranquilo até a confirmação final na blockchain — essa vaga é para você.

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional experiente para assumir as operações críticas de ativos digitais da empresa: exchanges, carteiras e custódia. Não é uma posição para quem está começando na área. É uma função de responsabilidade real, com acesso a ativos reais, decisões que importam e impacto direto no negócio.

O que você vai fazer

  • Administrar estruturas multi-sig e processos de custódia, incluindo definição e revisão de políticas de acesso e aprovação
  • Monitorar exposição, saldos e movimentações de ativos cripto em tempo real
  • Criar e aprimorar processos internos de controle, segurança e auditoria para operações com criptoativos
  • Atuar como referência técnica em questões de segurança de carteiras, gestão de chaves e prevenção de perdas
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de compliance, financeiro e tecnologia para manter as operações sólidas e escaláveis
Requisitos
  • Experiência comprovada operando em exchanges cripto, tanto CEX quanto DEX
  • Vivência prática com carteiras digitais — hot wallets, cold wallets, soluções multi-sig e custódia de ativos
  • Histórico real de gestão de operações com criptoativos (não apenas conhecimento teórico)
  • Rigor com segurança operacional: você entende que um erro nessa área pode custar caro, literalmente
  • Autonomia para tomar decisões e comunicar com clareza em ambientes de alta responsabilidade
  • Inglês para comunicação técnica é um diferencial
O que oferecemos
  • Remuneração: US$ 130.000 a US$ 150.000 por ano
  • Plano de saúde completo , sem letras miúdas
  • Modelo de trabalho flexível: remoto ou híbrido, conforme sua preferência
  • Autonomia real para estruturar e melhorar processos, não apenas executar
  • Um time que já entende do assunto — sem precisar explicar o que é gas fee

Não importa a cor da pele, raça, gênero, orientação sexual ou qualquer outra característica pessoal. Avaliamos todos os candidatos exclusivamente pelo conhecimento e experiência.

Se você respira mercado cripto e sabe a diferença entre segurança de verdade e segurança de fachada, queremos falar com você.

title: Remote Commercial Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's commercial and procurement legal work in Brazil: master services agreements, supply and distribution agreements, framework agreements, partnership and reseller contracts, and public procurement matters.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies — on both the buy side and the sell side.
  • Advise clients on public procurement: tender preparation and review, bid compliance, framework agreements, contract award procedures, and challenge / remedies processes.
  • Draft and negotiate SLAs, pricing and payment schedules, liability and indemnity frameworks, warranties, and termination provisions.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years practising commercial or procurement law in private practice or in-house.
  • Deep familiarity with commercial contracting — services, supply, distribution, licensing, liability, indemnities, and termination.
  • Public procurement grounding. Experience with public tender processes and procurement regulation (EU procurement directives or local equivalents), ideally from both the bidder and contracting-authority perspective.
  • Strong negotiation instincts. You know which points move the deal and which are noise.
  • Commercial fluency. You can read a pricing model, understand the business behind the contract, and ask the right questions.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

  • Work at the sharp end of high-volume commercial contracting — with AI tooling that removes the drudgery, not the judgment.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Overseas Pre-sales Engineer-Brazil
description:
Responsibility：

Solution Development and Customization：

  • Communicate deeply with customers (commercial enterprises, industrial customers, agricultural cooperatives or government agencies) to evaluate their energy needs (such as cost reduction, renewable energy integration or grid stability).
  • Work with internal technical teams to design and propose customized solutions, such as 1 MW to 3 MW photovoltaic systems, battery backup (BESS) or hybrid energy projects.
  • Integrate photovoltaic, energy storage or other technologies according to the customer's specific application scenarios (such as peak shaving, off-grid power supply or frequency regulation services) to ensure the absorption and competitiveness of the solution.

Sales and Business Development：

  • Develop and implement solutions sales strategies to achieve company revenue targets, especially in the fast-growing distributed PV and energy storage market in Brazil.
  • Identify potential customers and sales opportunities, and proactively promote company products and services, such as solutions for the southeast region with high electricity prices or the northeast region with abundant solar resources.
  • Convert potential customers into actual orders by demonstrating technical advantages and return on investment (ROI).

Bridging technology and business

  • Explain the technical details of the solution to customers (such as PV system efficiency, energy storage discharge time) and translate them into business language (cost savings, revenue improvement).
  • Prepare and present professional sales proposals, including technical specifications, financial models (such as payback period calculation) and project benefit analysis.
  • Submit high-quality proposals on behalf of the company and participate in negotiations in bidding or competition (such as the 2025 energy storage auction).

Customer Relationship and After-Sales Support

  • Serve as the customer's primary contact to ensure smooth progress from solution design to project delivery, and provide technical consultation and support.
  • Follow up the progress of project implementation, coordinate with the engineering team, and solve problems that arise during installation or operation.
  • Provide after-sales service suggestions (such as system upgrades, maintenance plans) to promote long-term cooperation and upsell.

Market Analysis and Product Feedback

  • Monitor Brazilian energy market trends, such as policy changes (Law 14.300, ANEEL Energy Storage Specifications), competitor dynamics, and customer demand changes.
  • Collect customer feedback and work with product development teams to optimize solutions (such as increasing storage capacity or reducing costs).
  • Report market insights to management regularly and recommend new product or service directions.

Cross-departmental collaboration

  • Work closely with the technical team to ensure that the solution complies with Brazilian grid standards (such as ONS requirements) and customer expectations.
  • Coordinate with the finance department to provide financing options (such as BNDES loans or installments) to help customers overcome financial barriers.
  • Liaise with procurement and supply chain teams to ensure timely delivery of equipment (such as PV modules, batteries).

Training and knowledge sharing

  • Provide technical training to sales teams or customers to explain the working principles and advantages of photovoltaic and energy storage systems.
  • Participate in industry events (such as energy exhibitions) to showcase company solutions and build brand influence.

Requirement：

Preferred:

  • Direct experience in the field of photovoltaics or energy storage, such as selling 1 MW to 3 MW photovoltaic systems or battery energy storage solutions.
  • Participation in project development in the Brazilian market, such as distributed generation or grid integration projects.

title: Account Manager
description:
We're Convert Sail, an e-commerce conversion optimization agency. We work with Shopify brands spending $100K-$1M+/month on ads, and we move fast. Really fast.

We're looking for an Account Manager to own client relationships and project delivery. You'll manage 8-10 client accounts, coordinate landing page and funnel builds with our design and dev team, and be the main point of contact when clients need something.

This isn't a 9-5 role where you clock out and forget about work. When a client has a launch on Saturday, you're online. When a project is behind, you stay late to fix it. We ship fast, we work weekends when it matters, and most people flame out in the first 90 days because they can't handle the pace.

If that scares you, this isn't the role for you.

If that excites you, keep reading.

What you'll do:

  • Own 8-10 client relationships and make sure they're happy, on track, and renewing long-term
  • Manage day-to-day client communication and set clear expectations
  • Coordinate landing page and funnel projects with our design and dev team—keep timelines tight and make sure nothing slips
  • Proactively identify and solve client issues before they become fires
  • Track project progress in ClickUp and ensure deadlines are met
  • Help clients see ROI from our work so they stick around for 6-12+ months, not 2-3
  • Be available during USA business hours and occasionally on weekends when client launches require it

What we're looking for:

  • 2+ years of experience managing client accounts in a fast-paced agency, SaaS company, or startup
  • Fluent English speaker with strong written and verbal communication skills
  • You've worked in high-pressure environments before and didn't crack under the weight
  • You're organized, proactive, and don't need someone checking in on you every 2 hours
  • You don't let things fall through the cracks—you follow up, you track details, you close loops
  • Experience with project management tools like ClickUp, Asana, or similar
  • Comfortable working remotely, but you don't treat "remote" like "invisible"
  • Bonus: Experience with e-commerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization (not required, but helpful)

What we offer:

  • Compensation: $12/hour ($2,000+/month full-time) + performance bonuses (depending on experience)
  • Fully remote—work from anywhere as long as you're available US hours
  • Work with real scaling brands, not broke startups or tire-kickers
  • Small team, so you'll have real impact and visibility
  • You'll learn more in 6 months here than 2 years at a slow-moving corporate job
  • Opportunity to grow into a senior role as the agency scales

How to apply:

Don't send a resume first.

Record a 4-minute Loom video (free tool, Google it if you don't know it) and tell us:

  1. Why you want this job
  2. Why we should hire you
  3. A time you had to manage a difficult client situation and how you handled it

Then email the Loom link to:

Subject line must include the word BUILDER. If it doesn't, we'll assume you can't follow instructions and we won't read your application.

If you can't handle recording a 4-minute video, you definitely can't handle this role.

title: Remote Real Estate Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's real estate work in Brazil: commercial leases, sale and purchase agreements, real estate aspects of corporate transactions, and development and construction agreements.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of leases and property transaction documents for clients ranging from startups taking their first office to enterprises managing property portfolios.
  • Run title review and property due diligence, including for real estate elements of M&A and financing transactions.
  • Advise on real estate financing and security, planning and zoning questions, and landlord-tenant matters.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years practising commercial real estate law in private practice or in-house.
  • Leasing depth. Office, retail, industrial, and flexible-space leases — rent review, service charges, repair obligations, break options, and assignments.
  • Transactional experience. Sale and purchase agreements, title review and due diligence, conditions, and completion mechanics.
  • Financing familiarity. Mortgages, security packages, and the real estate workstreams of corporate deals.
  • Practical judgment. You separate the points that protect the client from the points that stall the deal.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

  • Bring speed and clarity to real estate transactions traditionally slowed by process.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: FinCrime Analyst (Investigations) - Brazil
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people.

People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Financial Crime Operations is at the forefront of Revolut’s efforts to keep customers and their money safe. Team members work directly with customers to resolve issues and flag potential concerns. Using cutting-edge technology and sharp attention to detail, they help prevent financial crime and keep trust at the core of Revolut.

We’re looking for a Financial Crime Analyst to identify suspicious activity and ensure we’re treating customers fairly. You’ll be investigating internal SARs and complex cases by applying judgement, analytical skills, and solid decision-making to identify where grounds for suspicion of money laundering exist.

To support our 24/7 coverage, this role may include night and weekend shifts, which are fully compensated.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Reviewing, investigating, and reporting financial crime cases
  • Providing ongoing monitoring and resolving formal complaints and Financial Ombudsman Service complaints
  • Dealing appropriately with consent refusals following SAR submissions
  • Acting as a point of contact for law enforcement agencies in ongoing criminal investigations that commenced from a submitted SAR
  • Acting in accordance with written policies, procedures, and relevant legislation
  • Cooperating with other teams by providing professional and efficient front-line compliance support, seeking to improve company processes

What you'll need

  • A bachelor's degree (must be able to provide a certificate)
  • 3+ years in financial crime investigations, or 1+ years of SAR reporting experience
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (C1+ level)
  • Experience working in a regulated or policy-driven environment (e.g., financial institutions, law enforcement)
  • Experience with investigative methodologies, evidenced by the use of analytical tools (e.g., spreadsheets, filters, pivots, network charts)
  • The ability to work with multiple stakeholders and take ownership of assigned workload
  • Adaptability and experience with fast-cycle feedback
  • To be able to work a variety of shifts, including nights and weekends

Nice to have

  • Fluency in other languages
  • A degree in law or a STEM subject
  • A professional certification (e.g., ICA or ACAMS)
  • Familiarity with jurisdiction-specific financial regulations
  • Experience in crypto or blockchain analysis

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday.

We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

title: Remote Litigation Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's dispute resolution work in Brazil: commercial contract disputes, shareholder and post-M&A disputes, technology and IP disputes, debt recovery, and arbitration.
  • Lead case strategy, pleadings, evidence, and procedural steps for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies.
  • Advise clients on litigation risk before disputes arise — contract audits, escalation strategy, settlement positioning, and dispute resolution clauses.
  • Draft and negotiate letters before action, settlement agreements, and standstill and tolling arrangements; represent clients in mediation, arbitration, and court proceedings where licensed to do so.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years practising commercial litigation or arbitration in private practice or in-house.
  • Deep familiarity with contract disputes — breach, termination, damages, limitation of liability, and injunctive relief.
  • Advocacy and procedure. Confident managing proceedings end-to-end, with rights of audience or substantial arbitration experience (ICC, LCIA, or local institutions).
  • Strong drafting under pressure. Pleadings, witness statements, and settlement terms that hold up.
  • Commercial judgment. You know when to fight, when to settle, and how to explain the difference to a client.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

  • Bring modern tooling to dispute work — faster case preparation, sharper strategy, and clients who value clarity over billable churn.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: HRBP
description:
About Us

JD.com is building the world's most trusted technology and supply chain ecosystem. From our innovative roots in China, we have grown into a NASDAQ-listed, Fortune 44 global enterprise serving over 700 million active customers. Powered by advanced logistics networks, innovative technology, and a commitment to integrity, our business spans retail, logistics, technology, and real estate, dedicated to creating a smarter, faster, and more connected way of life. Through our digital intelligent cross-border supply chain and global logistics network, we continue to expand our international footprint, with operations across China, the United States, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, France, Germany, Spain, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and Brazil. You will join JD's overseas HR team, where we value collaboration, encourage ownership, and are committed to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Position Overview

As the HRBP in Brazil, you will serve as the strategic HR partner for JD's Brazil business team, deeply understanding business needs and providing comprehensive HR solutions for Brazilian operations, covering talent acquisition, organizational development, employee relations, and compliance management. Location: São Paulo, Brazil.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Partnership: Partner with business leadership to understand business priorities and provide strategic HR support to enhance organizational performance.
  • Talent Management: Lead talent management processes, including performance reviews, succession planning, and leadership development programs.
  • Recruitment Strategy: Develop and implement effective recruitment strategies to meet JD's staffing needs across business lines in Brazil.
  • Employee Relations: Manage employee relations, ensure a positive work environment, and address performance or behavioral issues in compliance with Brazilian labor law (CLT).
  • Change Management: Support organizational change and transformation initiatives aligned with JD's global vision.
  • Compliance & Benefits: Advise on compensation, benefits, and HR policies, ensuring full compliance with Brazilian Consolidation of Labor Laws (CLT), including severance regulations (FGTS), vacation and 13th-month salary provisions, occupational health and safety standards (NR regulations), and applicable federal labor regulations.
  • Data-Driven Insights: Utilize HR data and analytics to continuously improve HR programs and processes.
  • Culture Building: Promote employee engagement, diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) to strengthen JD's work culture.

Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years of HR Business Partner experience; background in cross-border e-commerce, retail, supply chain, or internet industry is preferred.
  • Communication: Fluent in English, both verbally and in writing; proficiency in Portuguese is highly preferred. Strong negotiation skills and the ability to navigate a global corporate structure.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiar with the talent landscape and operational characteristics of the Brazilian and Latin American market, with strong business acumen.
  • Core Competencies: Solid experience in performance management, talent development, employee relations, and organizational development.
  • Stakeholder Management: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Legal Expertise: Familiarity with Brazilian labor laws, including CLT, FGTS, INSS social security regulations, 13th-month salary (décimo terceiro) provisions, workplace health and safety norms (NR), and the Brazilian Labor Reform (Lei 13.467/2017). Knowledge of Brazilian union negotiations (acordos coletivos) is a plus.

What We Offer

Joining JD means becoming part of a company that seamlessly integrates talent, innovation, and impact. We offer: a competitive market compensation package (including expatriate allowances and benefits), comprehensive commercial insurance and medical coverage in Brazil, broad career development pathways and global project opportunities, an inclusive and diverse work culture where your voice will be heard, and a comprehensive expatriate support system for relocation and cross-cultural adaptation.

JD is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer and make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Vendedor de Sorvetes (Diversas Regiões do Brasil)
description:
A vida fica melhor com sorvete

Com 19.000 especialistas em sorvetes e marcas icônicas como Kibon, Cornetto e Ben & Jerry’s, amadas em 76 países, somos a maior empresa de sorvetes do mundo e líder do setor. Levamos o prazer a sério há mais de 100 anos, proporcionando felicidade a cada lambida ou bola de sorvete e criando momentos especiais para gerações.

A The Magnum Ice Cream Company é movida pelo crescimento: crescemos nosso negócio, impulsionamos o crescimento dos negócios dos nossos clientes e desenvolvemos a carreira das nossas pessoas. O crescimento começa com o empoderamento. Por isso, damos aos nossos colaboradores a liberdade para agir como empreendedores inovadores e responsáveis, motivados e preparados para oferecer aos nossos consumidores produtos excepcionais e momentos inesquecíveis — e se divertir ao longo dessa jornada.

Sobre a Função

Seu propósito será impulsionar a presença, o abastecimento e a visibilidade de Kibon no ponto de venda, executando o roteiro definido e assegurando os padrões de execução, para gerar crescimento sustentável da carteira e experiência de compra diferenciada.

Responsabilidades

  • Vendedor de Sorvetes é responsável por execução operacional e presença de Kibon nos PDVs da rota, com média de 20 visitas/dia, garantindo abastecimento, visibilidade, layout e precificação, excelência em Loja Brilhante, registro no Sistema de Vendas e estímulo ao pedido via Digital.
  • Roteiro & Produtividade: visitar em média 20 clientes por dia com disciplina e pontualidade, garantindo cobertura integral da carteira e continuidade dos atendimentos;
  • Execução de Loja: assegurar abastecimento, layout, precificação e materiais de visibilidade conforme guia de execução; realizar limpeza e conservação dos equipamentos; remover produtos estranho / danificados e / ou produtos que não sejam Kibon e que estejam presentes nos equipamentos.
  • Carteira: atua sob orientação e com responsabilidade direta pelos resultados da carteira.
  • Loja Brilhante: realizar a pesquisa de Loja Brilhante com evidências (fotos) e registrar a execução no aplicativo corporativo.
  • Sistemas & Dados: abrir/fechar visitas, registrar pedidos, ocorrências e evidências no sistema de vendas; utilizar os insights de vendas para priorização e melhoria de execução.
  • Pontos Quentes: negociar o melhor posicionamento dos equipamentos (pontos quentes) para maximizar visibilidade e giro.
  • Omnicanalidade do Pedido: orientar e influenciar o cliente a comprar via digital, quando aplicável, aumentando frequência e recorrência de pedidos.
  • Suporte Técnico: abrir e acompanhar chamados técnicos quando necessário em caso de quebra de equipamento, registrando aprovações/laudos conforme processo vigente.
  • Ativação & Desativação: negociar recolha/desativação de equipamentos, conforme diretrizes comerciais.
  • Prospecção: prospectar novos clientes na área de atuação, visando preenchimento e expansão de cobertura da rota.

Qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Desejável superior (incompleto) em andamento.
  • Vivência com vendas e execução de rotina comercial.
  • Facilidade com tecnologia (celular, apps de pedido, sistemas de vendas, excel básico, entre outros).
  • CNH B ativa e disponibilidade para deslocamentos diários na rota.

Por que se juntar a nós?

Aqui está o que define o sucesso em nossa organização:

  • Somos totalmente focados em crescimento.
  • Atuamos com velocidade e simplicidade.
  • Vencemos juntos, com diversão.
  • Somos corajosos para inovar e transformar nossa indústria.
  • Nós nos importamos com as pessoas e nos desafiamos constantemente.
  • Somos especialistas no negócio de sorvetes.

Este é um lugar para pessoas apaixonadas por sorvete e que buscam crescimento — tanto para o negócio quanto para si mesmas. Pessoas que agem como donas do negócio e conduzem tudo de ponta a ponta. Pessoas motivadas pelo sucesso, que entregam mais do que jamais imaginamos ser possível!

Você se encaixará aqui se valorizar uma cultura inclusiva e estiver entusiasmado(a) em aprender continuamente e desafiar a forma como trabalhamos, utilizando recursos digitais, dados e novas ideias para nos impulsionar cada vez mais.

Oferecemos

  • Cargos com verdadeira responsabilidade e impacto visível.
  • Liberdade para agir com rapidez, experimentar e desafiar a forma como as coisas são feitas.
  • Aprendizado e desenvolvimento contínuos, à medida que o negócio cresce.
  • Reconhecimento e recompensa alinhados ao desempenho e à contribuição de cada pessoa.

VOCÊ ESTÁ PRONTO(A) PARA CONSTRUIR O FUTURO DOS SORVETES?

Inscreva-se online e não se esqueça de enviar seu currículo. Sua candidatura será analisada de acordo com os requisitos da vaga, e entraremos em contato após o encerramento do processo para informar o status da sua inscrição.

Empregador que promove a igualdade de oportunidades

Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para contratação independentemente de raça, cor, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, expressão de gênero, origem nacional ou qualquer outra condição protegida pela legislação aplicável. title: Country Manager
description:
Job Summary

Own full P&L for Brazil business covering BESS, EV and Mobile Charging solutions, including utility‑scale, C&I and distributed segments. Responsible for end‑to‑end local operations: sales, solution design, project management, commissioning, after‑sales and full‑scope local team management. Align local execution with global HQ, deliver multi‑product business targets and build sustainable market presence.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Formulate Brazil multi‑product market strategy, budget and KPI breakdown; deliver annual revenue, shipment and project pipeline targets for BESS, EV and mobile charging.
  2. Develop distributors, EPCs, IPPs and key industrial clients; lead C‑level negotiation, bidding and commercial risk control across all product lines.
  3. Oversee full‑project lifecycle: pre‑sales solution design, project management, site commissioning supervision and after‑sales service to ensure on‑time, high‑quality delivery.
  4. Recruit, manage and develop cross‑functional local team (sales, solution, project, commissioning, after‑sales), drive overall team performance.
  5. Monitor local energy & e‑mobility policies, grid rules and competitor updates; feed market insights back to headquarters.
  6. Coordinate with HQ on demand forecasting, supply chain, pricing and risk assessment; align internal cross‑department resources.
  7. Maintain industry and stakeholder relationships to strengthen local brand influence.

Required Qualifications

  1. Bachelor’s degree in Electrical / Energy / Business related field; MBA preferred.
  2. 10+ years Brazil new‑energy B2B experience; minimum 10‑year hands‑on experience in BESS or e‑mobility business covering sales and project delivery.
  3. Proven P&L and cross‑functional team‑management track‑record; successful experience in MW‑level energy‑storage / EV‑related project delivery & partner ecosystem building.
  4. Solid knowledge of Brazil power market, e‑mobility regulation, tender and import compliance; existing connections with local EPC / IPP / industrial customers.
  5. Native Portuguese, business‑fluent English; Chinese or Spanish is a plus.
  6. Strong negotiation, cross‑team coordination & risk‑control skills. Experience at Chinese new‑energy OEM preferred.

• Facilidade para trabalhar com planilhas, sistemas de gestão e ferramentas digitais;

• Interesse em compreender processos comerciais, funis de vendas e jornadas de clientes;

• Perfil responsável, proativo, criterioso e comprometido com prazos;

• Capacidade de acompanhar simultaneamente diferentes demandas, pessoas e etapas do processo;

• Postura colaborativa para apoiar SDRs, consultores de negócios e diretoria;

• Disposição para aprender, documentar processos e propor melhorias;

• Familiaridade com Google Workspace ou ferramentas de escritório semelhantes;

• Interesse e facilidade para utilizar ferramentas de inteligência artificial no trabalho.

Diferenciais

title: Global HRBP
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Global HRBP to lead our HR operations in Brazil. This role will be responsible for managing 3PL labor vendor relationships, ensuring full compliance with Brazilian labor laws, driving local employee relations, and delivering data-driven HR insights to support our business growth in the region.

This is a standalone, high-impact role where you will act as the bridge between our local workforce and our global HR strategy, with a strong focus on operational excellence and cultural alignment.

Key Responsibilities

1. 3PL Workforce Management

  • Oversee local workforce deployment across warehouse and logistics operations (including Supervisor, Operator, and other roles); manage hiring cadence with labor vendors to ensure on-time staffing and operational continuity.

2. Labor Law & Compliance

  • Ensure full compliance with Brazilian labor laws, including but not limited to CLT, collective bargaining agreements, payroll regulations, and occupational health & safety requirements. Mitigate compliance risks through proactive monitoring and auditing.

3. Vendor Management & RFQ

  • Evaluate and onboard alternative labor vendors; lead RFQ benchmarking and contract negotiations. Build a multi-vendor strategy to ensure service continuity and cost efficiency.

4. Local Employee Relations

  • Handle employee relations matters including attendance, disciplinary actions, grievances, and terminations in accordance with Brazilian labor regulations. Foster a positive and inclusive workplace culture across multicultural teams.

5. HR Data & Reporting

  • Maintain and report on key HR metrics (headcount, attrition rate, hiring gaps, compliance status). Provide weekly reports to business leadership to support strategic decision-making.

Qualifications

  • Experience : 5+ years of HR experience, preferably in logistics, supply chain, or manufacturing sectors.
  • Vendor Management : Proven experience managing labor outsourcing and vendor contract negotiations.
  • Local Expertise : Deep understanding of Brazilian labor law, payroll practices, and regulatory environment.
  • Language Skills : Must be fluent in English, Mandarin, and Portuguese – you will work closely with global stakeholders and Chinese expatriate teams, as well as local Brazilian workforce.
  • Location : Based in São Paulo, with occasional travel to other Brazil sites as required.
  • Nationality : Brazilian candidates are strongly preferred.

Why Join Us

  • Global Platform – Be part of Lenovo's world-class supply chain ecosystem, operating across Brazil, China, Saudi, Mexico, and beyond.
  • Local Ownership – Take full ownership of HR operations in Brazil, with the autonomy to shape local policies and practices.
  • Multicultural Impact – Work in a dynamic, diverse environment where your work directly bridges cultures and drives operational success.
  • Competitive Rewards – We offer a competitive compensation package including medical insurance, retirement plans, performance bonuses, and more.

Our Commitment

We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace and proudly are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Sr Manager of Talent Acquisition
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a seasoned Talent Acquisition leader to head high-volume and specialized hiring roles for a scaling business in Brazil. This is a high-impact role responsible for building and executing recruiting strategy across multiple hiring funnels — from high-volume roles to niche, hard-to-fill specialized positions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and scale a Talent Acquisition team, setting strategy, processes, and performance standards across the full recruitment lifecycle.
  • Design and optimize recruiting workflows: sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer management, and onboarding
  • Build data-driven recruiting dashboards and SLAs; report on funnel health, time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, and quality-of-hire to senior leadership
  • Partner closely with HRBPs, business leaders, and hiring managers to understand headcount plans and translate them into executable hiring roadmaps
  • Manage external vendor relationships (agencies, job boards, etc) and negotiate terms to optimize cost and throughput
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian labor regulations throughout the hiring process
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of recruiters

Requirements

  • 10+ years of progressive Talent Acquisition experience, with strong exposure to full-cycle recruiting (sourcing through offer)
  • 4+ years of direct team leadership experience, managing recruiters/TA specialists
  • Proven track record of leading high-volume hiring in fast-paced, high-growth environments and specialized roles
  • Fluent English (written and verbal) — you will collaborate with global stakeholders and regional leadership
  • Deep knowledge of the Brazilian talent market, sourcing channels, and local labor practices
  • Strong analytical skills — comfortable building reports, tracking KPIs, and making data-informed decisions
  • Experience implementing or optimizing ATS systems and recruiting tech stacks
  • Hands-on mentality — willing to roll up sleeves when needed, not purely strategic

title: Coordenador(a) de Qualidade
description:
Resumo do cargo:

Se você é um profissional de Qualidade em busca de uma oportunidade para desenvolver sua carreira, esta vaga é para você.

Você será responsável por coordenar as atividades do time de Qualidade com responsabilidade pela gestão das pessoas, interfaces e qualidade das soluções técnicas.

Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

  • Liderar, desenvolver e acompanhar a equipe da Qualidade, distribuindo atividades, definindo prioridades e monitorando desempenho;
  • Gerenciar indicadores de qualidade (KPIs), analisando tendências e propondo planos de melhoria contínua;
  • Coordenar auditorias internas, externas e de clientes, incluindo auditorias de organismos certificadores e clientes estratégicos;
  • Atuar como responsável pela manutenção do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade, assegurando a atualização de procedimentos, instruções de trabalho e registros;
  • Gerenciar o tratamento de Não Conformidades (internas, clientes e fornecedores), conduzindo análise de causa raiz, definição de ações corretivas e verificação de eficácia;
  • Coordenar o processo de homologação, avaliação e desenvolvimento de fornecedores, acompanhando indicadores de desempenho e planos de ação;
  • Suportar processos de certificação e manutenção de certificados de produtos, acompanhando ensaios laboratoriais e documentação técnica junto aos órgãos certificadores;
  • Garantir a conformidade dos produtos com requisitos normativos, regulatórios e especificações de clientes;
  • Elaboração de Data Book – Petrobras;
  • Gerenciar processos de calibração de equipamentos de medição e monitoramento, garantindo rastreabilidade metrológica;
  • Coordenar inspeções de recebimento, processo e produto final, assegurando o cumprimento dos critérios de aceitação;
  • Atuar em conjunto com Engenharia, Produção, Supply Chain e Atendimento ao Cliente na resolução de problemas de qualidade;
  • Suportar projetos de melhoria contínua utilizando ferramentas Lean Manufacturing e Lean Six Sigma;
  • Elaborar apresentações gerenciais, reportando indicadores, riscos e planos de ação à liderança.

Quem você é:

Você apresenta elevado nível de atenção aos detalhes e compromisso com a qualidade, assegurando aderência rigorosa às diretrizes, instruções e padrões de processo estabelecidos pela organização. Combinando pensamento estratégico e execução prática, sendo capaz de traduzir metas em planos claros e realizáveis. Constrói relacionamentos baseados em confiança, escutando ativamente e ajustando sua abordagem conforme o contexto e as necessidades dos clientes, transmitindo mensagens de forma clara, convincente e concisa.. Você prevê conflitos antes que eles aconteçam, com base no conhecimento da dinâmica interpessoal e de grupo. A função exige, ainda, disciplina operacional, responsabilidade e zelo constante pelas pessoas, organização, segurança e ambiente de trabalho.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia (Qualidade, Produção, Mecânica, Elétrica, Automação ou áreas correlatas);
  • Experiência com qualificação de fornecedores e auditorias de qualidade;
  • Inglês avançado (para contato com fornecedores internacionais);
  • Conhecimento da ISO 9001;
  • Mínimo 3 anos de experiência liderando equipes na área de Qualidade e laboratório de Qualidade;
  • Conhecimentos avançados com pacote office 365 e suas ferramentas;
  • Local de trabalho: Barueri, SP.

Qualificações preferenciais que o diferenciam:

  • Desejável Pós Graduação em Gestão / Engenharia da Qualidade e Certificações relacionadas;
  • Conhecimento em Ferramentas Lean Manufacturing e 6-Sigma;
  • Conhecimento em ERP Omega da ABC71
  • Familiaridade com pacote office 365 e suas ferramentas
  • Leitura e interpretação de documentos em inglês

Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Kaspersky has been protecting individuals and corporate clients all over the world from cyber threats for 29 years.

title: Remote Investment Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's venture and investment work in Brazil: seed and growth equity rounds, SAFEs and convertible instruments, term sheets, shareholder agreements, and secondaries.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of investment documentation for founders, startups, angels, and funds — on both the company side and the investor side.
  • Run legal due diligence, manage closing processes and conditions precedent, and coordinate signing and completion.
  • Advise on cap table structuring, employee option plans (ESOPs), governance and board matters, and investor rights.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years practising venture capital, private equity, or corporate finance law in private practice or in-house.
  • Deep familiarity with investment documentation — term sheets, subscription and shareholders' agreements, SAFEs and convertible notes, and articles / constitutional documents.
  • Both-sides experience. You've acted for companies and for investors, and you know where each side's real risk sits.
  • Fluency in startup economics. Liquidation preferences, anti-dilution, vesting, option pools — and how they interact across rounds.
  • Speed with precision. Venture deals move fast; your documents still close cleanly.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

  • Work with ambitious founders and funds on deals that move fast — supported by tooling that keeps pace.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms.

• Experiência na condução de treinamentos, facilitação de grupos, elaboração de materiais e acompanhamento de planos de ação;

• Conhecimento em indicadores de RH, educação corporativa e gestão de programas de desenvolvimento;

• Pacote Office avançado;

Qual localidade?

Olímpia/SP

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. title: Attorney / Paralegal / Legal Assistant for US Law Firm
description:
We are hiring a Legal Support Professional to join the Brazil-based support team of a U.S. law firm. This position is based in Florianópolis, Santa Catarina , and requires strong professional English.

Location

Florianópolis, SC — Trindade and Centro

Moday through Friday (no weekends)

Hybrid flexibility available.

What You'll Do

Support a U.S.-based law firm throughout the case lifecycle, from intake through resolution.

  • Draft, format, and proofread correspondence, forms, and basic legal documents
  • Organize and maintain case files and records
  • Track deadlines and maintain case calendars
  • Coordinate scheduling and communications between clients, attorneys, and internal teams
  • Handle client intake and follow-up
  • Provide general administrative and case-management support

Who We're Looking For

We welcome candidates with different professional and educational backgrounds, including attorneys, law graduates, paralegals, legal assistants, and professionals with relevant administrative experience.

A specific degree or professional license is not required. Previous experience with a law firm or legal environment is a strong advantage.

  • Professional fluency in spoken and written English
  • Strong communication skills and professional phone etiquette
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple deadlines
  • Proficient with Microsoft Word, Outlook, and general office software
  • Able to handle confidential and privileged information responsibly
  • Previous legal, paralegal, or law firm experience is a plus
  • Conversational Spanish is a plus

Compensation

Monthly contractor compensation of USD $1,000 to $1,500 , depending on experience, qualifications, and English proficiency.

Candidates with previous experience working directly with U.S. law firms may be considered for a higher compensation range.

Schedule & Time Off

  • Weekends off
  • U.S. holidays observed
  • Up to 5 paid days off per year
  • Hybrid work flexibility

Compensation is all-inclusive.

Contract Structure

This position is offered by a U.S. company as an independent contractor engagement in Brazil and is not a Brazilian CLT employment position.

Candidates must be able to provide services through an appropriate Brazilian business structure, such as MEI or ME, where legally applicable. Candidates should consult their accountant regarding the appropriate structure for their individual circumstances.

How to Apply

Submit your resume in English through LinkedIn.

Because English is used throughout the workday with U.S.-based attorneys and clients, applications and interviews will be conducted in English.

Applicants may also optionally submit a brief 30-second English introduction video via WhatsApp at after applying.

    • Garantir a organização e o bom funcionamento dos ambientes corporativos; 
    • Estruturar, documentar e aprimorar processos internos sempre que necessário;
    • Atuar como ponto de apoio para lideranças e colaboradores em assuntos relacionados à gestão de pessoas e rotinas administrativas;
    • Monitorar indicadores da área e propor melhorias que contribuam para o desenvolvimento das equipes e da organização.

    Competências obrigatórias:

    • Experiência na organização de treinamentos e eventos corporativos.
    • EXPECTATIVAS

    O que buscamos:

    • Organização e proatividade: senso de prioridade, autonomia para conduzir múltiplas atividades;
    • Bom relacionamento interpessoal: interesse genuíno por pessoas, comunicação clara e acolhedora, capacidade de construir ambientes saudáveis e produtivos;
    • Pensamento analítico e estruturado: atenção aos detalhes, capacidade de análise e julgamento, habilidade para compreender perfis e identificar talentos;

title: Aviation Specialist
description:
Senior Non-Key Expert – Aviation Specialist

About NTU International A/S

NTU International A/S is a leading international consulting company providing project management and technical advisory services worldwide. NTU works extensively with European Union institutions, international financial institutions, development agencies, and public sector clients across transport, infrastructure, urban development, climate resilience, governance, and sustainable investment.

NTU International is preparing a proposal for the project “Global Gateway Transport and Urban Facility 2 – EC-INTPA/2026/EA-RP/0006.”

The overall objective of the project is to support the global transition towards inclusive, smart, clean, safe, secure, resilient and sustainable transport and cities in partner countries, in line with the Global Gateway strategy and the European Green Deal's geopolitical offer .

The contract will require the mobilisation of experts for technical assistance missions worldwide, with a particular focus on Sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America and the Caribbean, and Asia and the Pacific . The intended start date is January 2027 , with an implementation period of 48 months .

In this context, NTU International is seeking a highly qualified Senior Non-Key Expert – Aviation Specialist to support technical, policy, institutional and investment-related assignments in the aviation sector.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supporting the identification, preparation and implementation of aviation infrastructure and air transport projects.
  • Conducting feasibility studies, technical assessments, project design reviews and investment-related analyses.
  • Supporting airport master planning, infrastructure development and air connectivity planning.
  • Advising on airport infrastructure, airport systems, air transport services and operational efficiency.
  • Supporting aviation safety, security and compliance with relevant international and European standards and good practices.
  • Supporting procurement, tendering, implementation supervision, and operation and maintenance planning for aviation infrastructure.
  • Promoting sustainable and low-carbon aviation, including measures to improve energy efficiency and reduce the environmental footprint of airport operations.
  • Integrating climate resilience, disaster risk reduction and environmental and social considerations into aviation infrastructure planning and investment.
  • Supporting policy, regulatory and institutional reforms in the aviation sector.
  • Contributing to the assessment and improvement of investment climates and regulatory frameworks for aviation infrastructure and services.
  • Providing capacity building and technical assistance to civil aviation authorities, airport operators, public institutions and other sector stakeholders.
  • Coordinating with public authorities, civil aviation authorities, airport operators, airlines, contractors, supervising engineers, IFIs and development partners.
  • Supporting the promotion and adoption of European standards and good practices in partner countries.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Master’s degree or equivalent diploma in aeronautical engineering, airport engineering, civil engineering, transport engineering, aviation management , or another directly related discipline.
  • Excellent knowledge of the aviation sector, including airports, air transport, aviation safety, air connectivity and sustainability aspects , as well as related policies and international good practices.
  • Knowledge of development aid delivery methods.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Excellent computer skills.

General Professional Experience

  • At least 15 years of general professional experience in the aviation sector.
  • Proven experience managing complex assignments involving multiple stakeholders, including public authorities, civil aviation authorities, airport operators, airlines, contractors, supervising engineers and development partners.
  • Proven professional experience across the project cycle of aviation infrastructure and services investments, including feasibility studies, detailed design, tendering/procurement support, implementation, operation and maintenance planning.
  • Experience applying international and European standards and good practices related to aviation infrastructure and services delivery, including technical quality, safety, environmental and social compliance, climate resilience and sustainability considerations.

Specific Professional Experience

  • At least 7 years of professional experience in the planning, design, supervision or management of aviation infrastructure, airport systems and/or air transport services.
  • At least 5 years of professional experience in aviation projects in Sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America or Asia .
  • Professional experience related to the G20 Principles for Quality Infrastructure Investment in the aviation sector, in particular on the technical side, such as feasibility studies, project design, airport planning, aviation safety, social and environmental issues, maintenance, procurement, connectivity, operational efficiency and resilience, etc.

Assets

  • Professional experience in the Sub-Saharan Africa region (in situ).
  • Professional experience in providing support to governance / capacity building in the aviation sector.
  • Professional experience with the EU rules and procedures.

Language Requirements

  • English proficiency at C1 level is mandatory.
  • French at minimum B2 level will be considered an asset.
  • Spanish at minimum B2 level will be considered an asset.

Please note that inclusion in the expert pool does not guarantee immediate assignment. Experts will be contacted based on specific project requirements, availability and matching qualifications. Selected experts may be mobilised for short-term technical assistance missions in partner countries globally. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

  • Ser a referência técnica de processos industriais de pasteurização (HTST, HHST, UHT), homogeneização, fermentação, filtração por membranas (ultrafiltração e osmose reversa), separadores centrífugos, CIP/SIP, entre outros;

  • Garantir que toda documentação técnica de processos esteja atualizada e em conformidade com as especificações, e fluxogramas de engenharia;

description:

Temos uma cultura de expansão, crescemos todos anos. Estamos no Brasil todo. Você pode crescer muito mais em uma empresa em ascensão como a nossa.

Atualmente contamos com mais de 5.000 processos ativos em 14 áreas de atuação, realizando um atendimento de cerca de mais de 7.000 pessoas todos os meses por todo o Brasil.

title: Analista de operações
description:
Sobre o IBF

O IBF (Instituto Brasileiro de Florestas) atua com silvicultura de madeiras nobres desde 2006. Com sede em Londrina/PR e operação em Minas Gerais, tornou-se referência nacional no setor.

Estamos construindo uma cultura AI-first e buscamos pessoas que queiram aprender, assumir responsabilidades e melhorar processos.

Sobre a vaga

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Operações e Customer Success para organizar, acompanhar e aprimorar a operação do departamento responsável pelo relacionamento, sucesso e suporte pós-venda aos clientes.

A posição responderá diretamente à diretoria e apoiará três profissionais de Customer Success. Será responsável pela organização dos processos, operação do CRM, governança dos dados, controle de relatórios, acompanhamento dos indicadores e integração entre Customer Success, Operações Florestais, Financeiro, Comercial e Diretoria.

A função será predominantemente de bastidor. Entretanto, poderá realizar contatos específicos com clientes para envio de relatórios, aplicação de pesquisas de satisfação, atualização cadastral, cobrança de documentos ou contratos, confirmação de recebimento e outros procedimentos pontuais.

Missão da função

Garantir que os processos, dados, ferramentas, relatórios e fluxos da jornada pós-venda estejam organizados, mensurados e executados conforme as diretrizes da diretoria, apoiando a equipe de Customer Success, identificando riscos e propondo melhorias contínuas na experiência, retenção e sucesso dos clientes.

Responsabilidades

• Organizar e acompanhar a operação diária do departamento de Customer Success;

• Administrar o fluxo do pós-venda no CRM e nos demais sistemas utilizados pela empresa;

• Manter atualizados os cadastros, históricos, documentos e informações dos clientes;

• Realizar a segmentação dos clientes conforme os critérios estabelecidos pela diretoria;

• Organizar e acompanhar o onboarding de novos clientes;

• Apoiar a distribuição das carteiras, demandas e atividades entre os profissionais de Customer Success;

• Controlar registros de contatos, reuniões, solicitações, providências e retornos;

• Identificar clientes sem acompanhamento, registros incompletos, atividades vencidas e demandas sem resolução;

• Cobrar dos responsáveis a atualização das informações e o cumprimento dos procedimentos;

• Acompanhar pendências operacionais, técnicas, cadastrais e contratuais;

• Articular demandas com Operações Florestais, Financeiro, Comercial, Jurídico e demais áreas responsáveis;

• Apoiar os processos de renovação, retenção, indicação, upsell e cross-sell;

• Identificar gargalos e propor melhorias na jornada pós-venda;

• Organizar o calendário de relatórios periódicos enviados aos clientes;

• Reunir dados e cobrar informações das áreas responsáveis;

• Controlar responsáveis, prazos, aprovações, versões e histórico dos relatórios;

• Redigir, revisar, adaptar e diagramar relatórios e comunicações;

• Submeter os conteúdos técnicos à validação de Operações Florestais e da diretoria;

• Conferir dados, documentos, anexos, links e informações antes do envio;

• Apoiar os profissionais de Customer Success no envio e na apresentação dos relatórios;

• Realizar eventualmente o envio direto de materiais aos clientes;

• Realizar contatos específicos com clientes quando necessário;

• Apoiar pesquisas de NPS, CSAT e outras avaliações de satisfação;

• Apoiar a cobrança de contratos, aditivos e demais documentos;

• Apoiar ações e campanhas de relacionamento, retenção e engajamento;

• Organizar listas e segmentações de clientes para comunicações específicas;

• Criar, manter e aprimorar o health score da carteira de clientes;

• Classificar clientes conforme seu nível de relacionamento, engajamento e risco;

• Identificar clientes sem contato recente, insatisfeitos, inadimplentes ou com demandas recorrentes;

• Identificar riscos de cancelamento, reclamações e situações que exijam intervenção;

• Auditar registros de atendimentos, reuniões, mensagens, e-mails e demais interações;

• Verificar qualidade, clareza, completude, postura e cumprimento dos procedimentos;

• Organizar contratos, aditivos, documentos e informações cadastrais;

• Controlar vencimentos, reajustes, renovações e assinaturas;

• Apoiar a interlocução com o Financeiro em situações de inadimplência;

• Criar, atualizar e manter dashboards e relatórios gerenciais;

• Consolidar os indicadores da jornada pós-venda;

• Conferir a integridade, consistência e atualização dos dados;

• Preparar relatórios semanais e periódicos para a diretoria;

• Criar e atualizar scripts, modelos de e-mail, apresentações, pesquisas, formulários e checklists;

• Documentar processos e manter atualizados os playbooks e manuais do departamento;

• Apoiar a integração e o treinamento de novos profissionais de Customer Success.

Indicadores acompanhados

O profissional participará da consolidação e evolução de indicadores como:

• Clientes ativos e carteiras por responsável;

• Onboardings iniciados, pendentes e concluídos;

• Tempo de conclusão do onboarding;

• Cobertura e frequência de contato com a carteira;

• Clientes sem acompanhamento;

• Demandas abertas, concluídas e vencidas;

• Backlog, tempo de primeira resposta, tempo de resolução e cumprimento dos SLAs;

• Relatórios previstos, entregues e atrasados;

• NPS, CSAT e demais indicadores de satisfação;

• Reclamações, reincidências e motivos de insatisfação;

• Health score e distribuição dos clientes por nível de risco;

• Retenção, churn, cancelamentos, renovações e indicações;

• Oportunidades de upsell, cross-sell e receita de expansão;

• Reembolsos, inadimplência e pendências documentais ou contratuais;

• Qualidade e completude dos registros;

• Aderência aos processos e produtividade da equipe.

Não é necessário que o candidato já domine todos esses indicadores. Espera-se capacidade analítica e disposição para aprendê-los progressivamente com o apoio da diretoria e da equipe.

Sistemas, inteligência artificial e automações

• Operar e manter atualizados o Pipedrive, Zana, WhatsApp corporativo, e-mail, ERP, Google Workspace, Slack e o sistema florestal próprio da empresa;

• Apoiar a integração e o fluxo de informações entre os diferentes sistemas;

• Utilizar inteligência artificial para análise, redação, revisão, classificação e consolidação de informações;

• Criar e aprimorar prompts e assistentes para apoiar a equipe;

• Desenvolver automações para atividades recorrentes;

• Automatizar alertas de risco, pendências, vencimentos e prazos;

• Garantir que o uso das ferramentas respeite as políticas de segurança e confidencialidade.

Qualificações

• Graduação completa ou em andamento em Administração, Gestão Comercial, Marketing, Comunicação, Processos Gerenciais ou áreas relacionadas;

• Interesse ou experiência em Customer Success, atendimento, relacionamento ou pós-venda;

• Boa organização e atenção aos detalhes;

• Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita;

• Capacidade de redigir e revisar relatórios e comunicações;

• Raciocínio analítico e facilidade para trabalhar com indicadores;

• Facilidade para organizar tarefas, prazos, documentos e diferentes responsáveis;

• Capacidade de transformar diretrizes em processos, checklists e rotinas;

• Facilidade para trabalhar com planilhas, dashboards e sistemas de gestão;

• Perfil responsável, proativo, criterioso e comprometido com prazos;

• Postura profissional para lidar com informações sensíveis e clientes de alta renda;

• Disposição para documentar processos e propor melhorias;

• Interesse e facilidade para utilizar ferramentas de inteligência artificial.

Diferenciais

• Experiência em Customer Success, pós-venda, atendimento ou relacionamento com clientes;

• Experiência em operações, suporte administrativo ou gestão de processos;

• Conhecimento de Pipedrive ou outros sistemas de CRM;

• Experiência com Zana, ERP ou sistemas semelhantes;

• Familiaridade com indicadores de satisfação, retenção e churn;

• Experiência com dashboards, health score e classificação de risco;

• Experiência com contratos, documentos e relatórios;

• Conhecimento de auditoria ou controle de qualidade de atendimentos;

• Experiência com documentação de processos, playbooks e manuais;

• Familiaridade com automações e integrações entre sistemas;

• Bom repertório no uso profissional de ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot ou ferramentas semelhantes.

Não é necessário conhecer previamente o setor florestal. O conhecimento técnico será desenvolvido internamente.

Remuneração e benefícios

• Salário fixo de R$ 3.500,00;

• Vale-transporte;

• Vale-alimentação;

• Plano de saúde e odontológico;

• Wellhub/Gympass.

Não haverá remuneração variável para esta posição.

Horário e modelo de trabalho

Vaga CLT, presencial em Londrina/PR, com início imediato. De segunda a quinta-feira, das 8h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. Às sextas-feiras, das 8h às 12h e das 13h às 17h.

description:
